title: In illa die suscipiam te (Liber septimus) (Conseil)
desc: Jean Conseil, In illa die suscipiam te (Liber septimus). 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Liber septimus. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
